title: PostReady: PR #565 — Fix homepage TikTok link points at our handle
description: Fixed the TikTok link on the homepage to correctly point to PostReady's own TikTok handle rather than an incorrect or placeholder URL.

title: PostReady: PR #564 — Remove platform counts from copy + sell post packs, not AI images
description: Removed platform count metrics from marketing copy and reframed the product value proposition around selling post packs rather than raw AI image generation.

title: PostReady: PR #563 — Redesign pack meter as a stat card
description: Redesigned the post pack usage meter as a stat card component for a cleaner, more informative display of pack consumption and remaining allowance.

title: PostReady: PR #562 — Add post-pack explainer to pricing page
description: Added a post-pack explainer section to the pricing page to help users understand how post pack allowances work across tiers.

title: PostReady: PR #561 — Pack usage meter reads the plan tier's allowance
description: Fixed the pack usage meter to correctly read the allowance for the user's actual plan tier rather than a hardcoded or incorrect value.

title: PostReady: PR #558 — Align Connect button on Connect Socials cards
description: Fixed alignment of the Connect button on Connect Socials cards for consistent layout across all connected social platform cards.

title: PostReady: PR #557 — Premium frosted social cards (subtle per-platform gradient system)
description: Connected social platform cards upgraded to a premium frosted glass aesthetic with a subtle, refined per-platform gradient system — more polished than the bold Design 4 gradients.

title: PostReady: PR #556 — Bolder platform gradients + gradient on available cards
description: Strengthened per-platform gradient intensity on connected social cards and extended the gradient treatment to available (not-yet-connected) platform cards.

title: PostReady: PR #555 — Connected social cards: per-platform gradients (Design 4)
description: Connected social platform cards now use per-platform gradient backgrounds (Design 4), giving each platform a distinct visual identity on the dashboard.

title: PostReady: PR #554 — Don't reject a website typed without http://
description: Relaxed website URL validation to accept domains entered without http:// prefix, auto-normalizing them so users aren't blocked by a formatting requirement.
